payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate over all possible target positive integers t from 1 to max(a). For each t, compute the total minimal cost to make all stick lengths almost good for t (by summing max(0, |a_j - t| - 1)). Keep the t with minimum total cost.
payload.rationale: The solution performs an exhaustive search over all possible t values (up to 100), making it a complete search. Sorting is present but unused. Among the given complete_search subtypes, 'search_backtracking' is the most general exhaustive search label, even though no recursive backtracking occurs.
